subject: PulseNova: Packaging swap + Year‑One true‑up — exec signoff request
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: PulseNova packaging swap + year‑one true‑up — signoff request

Hannah / Kim — forwarding the carrier thread with PulseNova. TL;DR: they want to swap 40% of their initial committed seats into a lower compute packaging (mixed quantized variant) for year‑one to stay within their budget; in exchange they will accept a 6% true‑up at the end of the year (based on actual usage) and accelerate payment terms by 15 days.

Why we need exec signoff: the swap reduces expected unit revenue in Y1 by ~22% versus the originally quoted package and pushes additional risk to us for usage variability. Commercial is asking for a one‑time onboarding credit to soften the net present value hit — we recommend a $45k onboarding credit conditional on the true‑up guarantee (see attachment).

Attachments: PulseNova_packaging_swap_summary.pdf (one‑pager summary), Deal_Risk_Memo_PulseNova.xlsx (model + sensitivity).

Request: Hannah, can you escalate for VP/CFO signoff? If acceptable, please loop in Karthik for the final finance OK and Vivek for approval on the SLA/pack changes.

Thanks —
Marissa 
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415‑555‑0137

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Jan 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: PulseNova packaging swap + year‑one true‑up — signoff request

Appreciate the summary, Marissa. Quick comments from commercial/legal perspective:
- The packaging change is straightforward (we can deliver the quantized instance family) but the proposed onboarding credit is larger than our standard onboarding concession for pilot→production (typical range $10–25k).
- The 6% true‑up makes sense but we need the true‑up formula in the contract (usage bands + reconciliation timeline).
- Accelerated payment terms (net‑30 → net‑15) materially increase cash risk; if we shorten payment terms we should require either (a) guaranteed commit with penalty bands or (b) an initial partial prepayment.

I suggest we reduce the credit to $30k and add a milestone: they make a 25% prepayment on signature (applied to onboarding credit). That keeps commercial relief but protects cash.

Kim
Kimberly Park | Head of Commercial Contracts, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@pulsenova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@pulsenova.com>, purchasing@pulsenova.com
Date: Fri, 06 Jan 2028 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PulseNova packaging swap + year‑one true‑up — signoff request

Hi Marissa / Hannah — thanks for the quick analysis. A few clarifications from our side:
1) The swap to the mixed quantized variant is critical: it reduces our projected infra spend by ~18% and keeps the pilot within budget.
2) We are comfortable with a 6% year‑end true‑up but need the reconciliation window to be 60 days after year end (finance cycle constraint).
3) Regarding payment terms, we can do the 25% prepayment at signature. We cannot take penalties on the commit, but we are willing to add a short‑term usage floor (equivalent to 50% of the original month 1 forecast for months 1–3).

If you can accept the 25% prepayment + 60‑day reconciliation, we can move quickly to finalize.

Best,
Oliver Grant
Head of Data Platform, PulseNova
oliver.grant@pulsenova.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Jan 2028 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Updated memo: reduced credit + prepayment and reconciliation terms

Hannah / team — updated ask following Kim & PulseNova feedback. Summary of the revised ask (attachment included):
- Onboarding credit: $30,000 (one‑time), applied as a credit on first invoice.
- Prepayment: 25% of first year ARR due on signature; prepayment reduces onboarding credit dollar for dollar.
- Packaging swap: 40% of committed seats moved to mixed‑quantized variant Y1.
- True‑up: 6% reconciliation applied at year end with a 60‑day reconciliation window.
- Usage floor: 50% of original month‑1 forecast for months 1–3 (controls downside).

Risk summary: net present value impact to Redwood across year‑one is ~‑$18k with the revised $30k credit and prepayment. Upside: customer is committing to 12 months and signs within Q1; they are a strategic reference in the medtech space (high leverage).

Attachments: Deal_Risk_Memo_PulseNova.xlsx (updated numbers).

Request: Seeking VP/CFO signoff to proceed with the commercial package as described; if approved, I will instruct Legal to prepare an amendment and a DocuSign package.

Thanks —
Marissa

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Jan 2028 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Updated memo: reduced credit + prepayment and reconciliation terms — please advise / signoff

Karthik / Vivek — please see the attached ask for PulseNova. Commercial recommends the $30k onboarding credit plus 25% prepayment and the 60‑day true‑up. Key points for finance: the NPV impact is modest (~$18k) and the customer is high‑value for references. Key points for ops: packaging swap is supported by infra (we can deliver the quantized family) but ask that we add a rollback window for the first 30 days in case of performance/regression.

Can you confirm: (1) CFO signoff on the $30k onboarding credit and prepayment (2) VP approval on the rollback SLA window? If we get both, we will send the amendment to PulseNova and route a DocuSign.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Jan 2028 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Updated memo: reduced credit + prepayment and reconciliation terms — please advise / signoff

Hannah — I reviewed the numbers in Deal_Risk_Memo_PulseNova.xlsx. I can approve the $30k onboarding credit on the conditions below:
1) 25% prepayment at signature applied to onboarding credit (non‑refundable after 30 days).
2) Finance holds a 10% holdback on milestone invoices for 90 days to cover reconciliation uncertainty (apply to months 1–3).
3) Legal to include the 60‑day reconciliation window and the true‑up formula.

If we get the customer to accept the prepayment and the holdback, I will sign off and Marissa can proceed to get the amendment executed. Vivek — please confirm the rollback SLA window is operationally acceptable; otherwise we should add a performance breakpoint clause.

Karthik Iyer
VP, Finance (Interim CFO) | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
